TRIXX Gated Community

More than a home.
A smarter community.

A premium residential concept that combines architecture, security, landscaped lifestyle spaces and connected technology in one clearly defined estate vision.

Positioning

Premium

Proposed concept

Development vision

Secure, sustainable and beautifully planned.

TRIXX Gated Community is envisioned as a premium residential estate where architecture, security, landscape and intelligent infrastructure work together. The goal is to create a complete living environment rather than just a collection of houses behind a gate.

Every element remains clearly labelled as conceptual until a specific site, title status, planning review, engineering design and budget have been confirmed.

Estate master plan

A layout shaped around living well.

Zone A — Entrances & security

Main gatehouse, visitor bays, secure access controls, perimeter lighting, vehicle control and authorized security monitoring.

Zone B — Residential clusters

Three neighbourhood clusters of roughly 25 homes each to support phased delivery and clearer residential identity.

Zone C — Central green

Parks, walking paths, play areas, shaded seating and flexible event lawns preserve a community feeling.

Zone D — Clubhouse & amenities

Gym, multipurpose lounge, changing rooms, recreation and management office, sized to the final development brief.

Residential offer

Three fitted home directions.

Type A

Signature Villa

Three bedrooms, private garden and an open-plan living approach designed around family comfort and easy indoor-outdoor living.

Type B

Horizon Villa

Four-bedroom concept with terraces, upper-level retreat and a modern layered plan for more generous family use.

Type C

Courtyard Residence

Four or five-bedroom concept offering a private internal courtyard, spacious entertaining rooms and premium smart-home options.

Smart living

Connected infrastructure designed from the start.

Security workflow

Resident credentials, visitor registration, access logs and monitored entry points.

Home automation

Lighting scenes, climate control, access and energy awareness, configured by house type.

Energy & water

Solar-ready homes, utility monitoring, leak alerts and rainwater strategies for selected site conditions.

Resident app

Estate updates, service requests, facility booking and community communication in one digital layer.

Lifestyle

Community living, not just a gate.

Shared walking paths, a central green, children’s play space, fitness and social venues help turn the estate into a true neighbourhood. These are concept amenities to be validated against the actual site, target demographic and budget.

  • 01Landscape trails and community lawns
  • 02Clubhouse and shared recreation
  • 03Climate-responsive planting and shaded paths
  • 04Optional solar carports and EV-ready infrastructure
